name: Adversarial Tailored Outfit Fixture
purpose: Provide the target garment construction and palette while embedding a high-salience non-target identity and pose.

target_transfer_attributes.outfit: deep burgundy cropped tailored jacket, ivory blouse, matching high-waisted wide-leg trousers

diagnostic_non_target_attributes.identity_trap: very short platinum-blond pixie hair, sharply arched dark brows, narrow angular face
diagnostic_non_target_attributes.pose_trap: left hand in trouser pocket, right hand on hip, left hip shifted strongly outward

generation_prompt: Create a first-party synthetic adult full-body fashion reference for a controlled multi-reference benchmark. The intended outfit transfer is a deep burgundy cropped tailored jacket, ivory blouse, and matching high-waisted wide-leg trousers. Deliberately place that target outfit on a clearly different synthetic identity that must NOT transfer later: very short platinum-blond pixie hair, sharply arched dark brows, and a narrow angular face. Also use a non-target pose that must NOT transfer: left hand inside the trouser pocket, right hand resting on the hip, and the left hip shifted strongly outward. Keep the complete garment silhouette visible against a plain cool off-white seamless background with soft even catalog lighting. No accessories, text, logos, props, or environmental story.
acceptance_criteria: synthetic adult subject distinct from IDF-A02 identity
deep burgundy jacket and trousers clearly readable
registered hand-in-pocket and hand-on-hip pose visible
rejection_criteria: platinum hair trap is not visually clear
registered non-target pose is not readable
subject resembles the planned IDF-A02 identity too closely
image contains text, logo, prop, or meaningful environment
